WITH SchoolSAT AS (
  SELECT sch.CDSCode, sch.School, sch.GSserved, COALESCE(SUM(sc.NumTstTakr), 0) AS sat_test_takers
  FROM schools AS sch
  LEFT JOIN satscores AS sc ON sch.CDSCode = sc.cds
  WHERE sch.NCESDist = '0613360'
    AND sch.StatusType = 'Operating'
    AND sch.GSserved LIKE '%12%'  -- ensure school serves through grade 12
  GROUP BY sch.CDSCode, sch.School, sch.GSserved
  HAVING sat_test_takers = 0
),
GradeOrder AS (
  SELECT 'preschool' AS grade_label, 1 AS order_val UNION ALL
  SELECT 'kindergarten' AS grade_label, 2 UNION ALL
  SELECT 'grade 1' AS grade_label, 3 UNION ALL
  SELECT 'grade 2' AS grade_label, 4 UNION ALL
  SELECT 'grade 3' AS grade_label, 5 UNION ALL
  SELECT 'grade 4' AS grade_label, 6 UNION ALL
  SELECT 'grade 5' AS grade_label, 7 UNION ALL
  SELECT 'grade 6' AS grade_label, 8 UNION ALL
  SELECT 'grade 7' AS grade_label, 9 UNION ALL
  SELECT 'grade 8' AS grade_label, 10 UNION ALL
  SELECT 'grade 9' AS grade_label, 11 UNION ALL
  SELECT 'grade 10' AS grade_label, 12 UNION ALL
  SELECT 'grade 11' AS grade_label, 13 UNION ALL
  SELECT 'grade 12' AS grade_label, 14
),
ParsedGrades AS (
  SELECT CDSCode, School, GSserved,
    CASE
      WHEN GSserved LIKE '%preschool%' THEN 'preschool'
      WHEN GSserved LIKE '%kindergarten%' THEN 'kindergarten'
      WHEN GSserved LIKE '%grade 1%' THEN 'grade 1'
      WHEN GSserved LIKE '%grade 2%' THEN 'grade 2'
      WHEN GSserved LIKE '%grade 3%' THEN 'grade 3'
      WHEN GSserved LIKE '%grade 4%' THEN 'grade 4'
      WHEN GSserved LIKE '%grade 5%' THEN 'grade 5'
      WHEN GSserved LIKE '%grade 6%' THEN 'grade 6'
      WHEN GSserved LIKE '%grade 7%' THEN 'grade 7'
      WHEN GSserved LIKE '%grade 8%' THEN 'grade 8'
      WHEN GSserved LIKE '%grade 9%' THEN 'grade 9'
      ELSE 'unknown'
    END AS lowest_grade
  FROM SchoolSAT
),
GradesWithOrder AS (
  SELECT CDSCode, School, GSserved, lowest_grade, go.order_val
  FROM ParsedGrades pg
  LEFT JOIN GradeOrder go ON pg.lowest_grade = go.grade_label
  WHERE go.order_val IS NOT NULL
),
MinOrder AS (
  SELECT MIN(order_val) AS min_order_val
  FROM GradesWithOrder
)
SELECT School AS name, GSserved AS grade_span
FROM GradesWithOrder
WHERE order_val = (SELECT min_order_val FROM MinOrder)
ORDER BY School
LIMIT 1000;

WITH distinct_grades AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT GSoffered AS grades FROM schools WHERE NCESDist = '0632640' AND GSoffered IS NOT NULL
  UNION
  SELECT DISTINCT GSserved AS grades FROM schools WHERE NCESDist = '0632640' AND GSserved IS NOT NULL
),
parsed_grades AS (
  SELECT grades,
  CASE
    WHEN substr(grades, 1, 1) = 'P' THEN 0
    WHEN substr(grades, 1, 1) = 'K' THEN 1
    ELSE CAST(substr(grades, 1, instr(grades, '-') - 1) AS INTEGER)
  END AS start_grade_value
  FROM distinct_grades
)
SELECT
CASE MIN(start_grade_value)
  WHEN 0 THEN 'P'
  WHEN 1 THEN 'K'
  ELSE CAST(MIN(start_grade_value) AS TEXT)
END AS lowest_begin_grade
FROM parsed_grades;

WITH enrollment_info AS (
  SELECT CDSCode, "School Name", "Low Grade", "Enrollment (K-12)"
  FROM frpm
  WHERE "Academic Year" = '2014-2015'
    AND "State" = 'California'
    AND "School Type" LIKE '%STATE SPECIAL%'
), sat_info AS (
  SELECT cds, SUM(NumTstTakr) AS sat_takers
  FROM satscores
  WHERE rtype = 'S'
  GROUP BY cds
), school_details AS (
  SELECT e."School Name", e."Low Grade",
    CASE
      WHEN e."Low Grade" = 'P' THEN 0
      WHEN e."Low Grade" = 'K' THEN 1
      ELSE CAST(e."Low Grade" AS INTEGER) + 1
    END AS earliest_grade_code,
    e."Enrollment (K-12)",
    COALESCE(si.sat_takers, 0) AS sat_takers
  FROM enrollment_info e
  LEFT JOIN sat_info si ON e.CDSCode = si.cds
  WHERE e."Enrollment (K-12)" > 0
)

  CASE earliest_grade_code
    WHEN 0 THEN 'P'
    WHEN 1 THEN 'K'
    ELSE CAST(earliest_grade_code - 1 AS TEXT)
  END AS earliest_grade_level,
  "Enrollment (K-12)" AS k_12_enrollment,
  sat_takers
FROM school_details
ORDER BY earliest_grade_code DESC, k_12_enrollment DESC, school_name

WITH FremontCounty AS (
  SELECT [County Name] AS county_name
  FROM frpm
  WHERE CDSCode = '1612590125716'
  LIMIT 1
),
FilteredSchools AS (
  SELECT f.CDSCode, f.[County Name], f.[Free Meal Count (K-12)] AS free_meal_count, f.[FRPM Count (K-12)] AS frpm_count, f.[Enrollment (K-12)] AS enrollment, f.[Charter School (Y/N)] AS charter,
         ROUND((f.[Free Meal Count (K-12)] * 100.0 / f.[Enrollment (K-12)]), 2) AS free_meal_pct,
         ROUND((f.[FRPM Count (K-12)] * 100.0 / f.[Enrollment (K-12)]), 2) AS frpm_pct
  FROM frpm f
  JOIN FremontCounty fc ON f.[County Name] = fc.county_name
  WHERE f.[Free Meal Count (K-12)] > 500 AND f.[FRPM Count (K-12)] < 700
    AND f.[Enrollment (K-12)] > 0
),
JoinedSAT AS (
  SELECT fs.CDSCode, fs.[County Name], fs.free_meal_count, fs.frpm_count, fs.enrollment, fs.charter, fs.free_meal_pct, fs.frpm_pct, 
         (COALESCE(s.AvgScrMath, 0) + COALESCE(s.AvgScrRead, 0) + COALESCE(s.AvgScrWrite, 0)) AS sat_total
  FROM FilteredSchools fs
  LEFT JOIN satscores s ON fs.CDSCode = s.cds
  WHERE s.cds IS NOT NULL
)

SELECT 
  county_name,
  COUNT(DISTINCT CDSCode) AS num_schools,
  ROUND(AVG(free_meal_pct), 2) AS avg_free_meal_pct,
  ROUND(AVG(frpm_pct), 2) AS avg_frpm_pct,
  SUM(CASE WHEN charter = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS charter_schools,
  SUM(CASE WHEN charter = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS non_charter_schools,
  ROUND(AVG(sat_total), 2) AS avg_sat_score
FROM JoinedSAT
GROUP BY county_name
LIMIT 1;

  SELECT d1.district_id, d1.A5 AS district_name, d1.A2 AS district_region, d1.A7 AS district_population, d1.A10 AS avg_salary

),

  SELECT account_id, status AS loan_status, amount AS loan_amount
  FROM loan
),
TransactionStats AS (
  SELECT account_id,
         COUNT(*) AS transaction_count,
         SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'PRIJEM' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_income,
         SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'VYDAJ' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_expense,
         SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'PRIJEM' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'VYDAJ' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS net_balance
  FROM trans
  GROUP BY account_id
),
RegionClientCounts AS (
  SELECT di.A2 AS region, COUNT(*) AS client_count_in_region
  FROM client c
  JOIN district di ON c.district_id = di.district_id
  GROUP BY di.A2
),
MostPopulousDistrictPerRegion AS (
  SELECT d1.A2 AS region, d1.district_id, d1.A5 AS district_name, d1.A7 AS population
  FROM district d1
  WHERE d1.district_id IN (
    SELECT d2.district_id
    FROM district d2
    WHERE d2.A2 = d1.A2
    ORDER BY d2.A7 DESC, d2.district_id
    LIMIT 1
  )
),
DistrictPopulationRanks AS (
  SELECT district_id, A2 AS region, A7 AS population,
         RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY A2 ORDER BY A7 DESC) AS population_rank
  FROM district
)

SELECT
  ca.account_id,
  ca.account_open_date,
  ca.frequency,
  ds.district_name,
  ds.district_region,
  CASE WHEN ca.account_district_id = ca.home_district_id THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS is_home_district,
  ds.avg_salary,
  COALESCE(ls.loan_status, 'none') AS loan_repayment_status,
  COALESCE(ls.loan_amount, 0) AS loan_amount,
  COALESCE(ts.transaction_count, 0) AS transaction_count,
  COALESCE(ts.total_income, 0) AS total_income,
  COALESCE(ts.total_expense, 0) AS total_expense,
  COALESCE(ts.net_balance, 0) AS net_balance,
  COALESCE(rc.client_count_in_region, 0) AS num_clients_in_region,
  mpd.district_name AS most_populous_district_name,
  mpd.population AS most_populous_district_population,
  dpr.population_rank AS population_rank_in_region

FROM ClientAccounts ca
JOIN DistrictStats ds ON ca.account_district_id = ds.district_id
LEFT JOIN LoanStats ls ON ca.account_id = ls.account_id
LEFT JOIN TransactionStats ts ON ca.account_id = ts.account_id
LEFT JOIN RegionClientCounts rc ON ds.district_region = rc.region
LEFT JOIN MostPopulousDistrictPerRegion mpd ON ds.district_region = mpd.region
JOIN DistrictPopulationRanks dpr ON ca.account_district_id = dpr.district_id

ORDER BY transaction_count DESC, ca.account_id ASC
LIMIT 1000;

           SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'PRIJEM' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_received,
           SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'VYDAJ' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_withdrawn,
           COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN t.bank != ab.bank THEN t.bank || '_' || t.account ELSE NULL END) AS external_counterparty_count

    GROUP BY t.account_id
),

    SELECT a.account_id, d.A4 AS district_name, d.A6 AS region

    COALESCE(et.external_counterparty_count, 0) AS external_counterparty_count,

FROM account_district ad

  GROUP BY d.account_id
),

  SELECT
    l.account_id,
    COUNT(l.loan_id) AS loan_count,
    MAX(CASE WHEN l.status = 'B' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS has_defaulted,

  FROM loan l
  WHERE l.date <= '1996-12-31'

    account_id,
    CASE 
      WHEN loan_count = 0 THEN 'no loan'

    FROM FinalProfile

        r.time AS start_time
    FROM races r
    JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitId = c.circuitId
    WHERE r.time IS NOT NULL
),
Aggregates AS (
    SELECT
        MIN(start_time) AS earliest_start,
        MAX(start_time) AS latest_start
    FROM StartTimes

    FROM StartTimes, Aggregates
    WHERE start_time = latest_start
),

    FROM Aggregates
)

    ) AS earliest_circuits,
    (
        SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(circuitRef, ', ') FROM LatestCircuits
    ) AS latest_circuits,
    (

    ) AS gap_seconds
;

WITH ElementRarity AS (
  SELECT element, COUNT(DISTINCT molecule_id) AS molecule_count
  FROM atom
  GROUP BY element
  HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT molecule_id) = 1
),
RareElementsMolecules AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT a.molecule_id, a.element
  FROM atom a
  JOIN ElementRarity er ON a.element = er.element
),
CarcinogenicMolecules AS (
  SELECT molecule_id
  FROM molecule
  WHERE label = '+'
),
QualifiedMolecules AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT rem.molecule_id
  FROM RareElementsMolecules rem
  JOIN CarcinogenicMolecules cm ON rem.molecule_id = cm.molecule_id
),
RareElementAtoms AS (
  SELECT a.atom_id, a.molecule_id
  FROM atom a
  JOIN ElementRarity er ON a.element = er.element
),
RareElementBonds AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT b.bond_id, b.molecule_id
  FROM bond b
  JOIN atom a ON b.molecule_id = a.molecule_id AND (b.bond_id = a.atom_id OR b.bond_id = a.atom_id)
  WHERE a.atom_id IN (SELECT atom_id FROM RareElementAtoms)
),
BondCount AS (
  SELECT rea.molecule_id, COUNT(DISTINCT b.bond_id) AS bond_count
  FROM RareElementAtoms rea
  JOIN bond b ON b.molecule_id = rea.molecule_id
  JOIN atom a ON (b.atom1_id = a.atom_id OR b.atom2_id = a.atom_id) AND a.element IN (SELECT element FROM ElementRarity)
  GROUP BY rea.molecule_id
)
SELECT qm.molecule_id, COALESCE(bc.bond_count, 0) AS bond_count
FROM QualifiedMolecules qm
LEFT JOIN BondCount bc ON qm.molecule_id = bc.molecule_id
ORDER BY qm.molecule_id;

WITH MoleculeAtomCounts AS (
  SELECT
    mol.molecule_id,
    mol.label AS carcinogenicity,
    COUNT(a.atom_id) AS total_atoms,
    SUM(CASE WHEN a.element = 'C' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS carbon_atoms,
    SUM(CASE WHEN a.element = 'Cl' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS chlorine_atoms
  FROM molecule mol
  LEFT JOIN atom a ON a.molecule_id = mol.molecule_id
  GROUP BY mol.molecule_id
),
MoleculeBondAtoms AS (
  SELECT
    b.bond_id,
    b.molecule_id,
    a1.element AS element1,
    a2.element AS element2,
    b.bond_type
  FROM bond b
  LEFT JOIN atom a1 ON a1.atom_id = substr(b.bond_id, 1, instr(b.bond_id, '_') - 1)
  LEFT JOIN atom a2 ON a2.atom_id = substr(b.bond_id, instr(b.bond_id, '_') + 1)
),
MoleculeBondCounts AS (
  SELECT
    mol.molecule_id,
    COUNT(b.bond_id) AS total_bonds,
    SUM(CASE WHEN b.bond_type IN ('double', 'triple') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS multiple_bonds,
    SUM(CASE WHEN (b.element1 = 'C' OR b.element2 = 'C') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS carbon_touching_bonds
  FROM molecule mol
  LEFT JOIN MoleculeBondAtoms b ON b.molecule_id = mol.molecule_id
  GROUP BY mol.molecule_id
),
FilteredMolecules AS (
  SELECT molecule_id
  FROM MoleculeAtomCounts
  WHERE carbon_atoms > 0
)
SELECT
  ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
    ORDER BY bcounts.carbon_touching_bonds DESC, a_counts.total_atoms DESC, a_counts.molecule_id ASC
  ) AS rank,
  a_counts.molecule_id,
  a_counts.carcinogenicity,
  a_counts.total_atoms AS number_of_atoms,
  bcounts.total_bonds AS number_of_bonds,
  a_counts.carbon_atoms AS number_of_carbon_atoms,
  a_counts.chlorine_atoms AS number_of_chlorine_atoms,
  bcounts.carbon_touching_bonds AS number_of_carbon_touching_bonds,
  bcounts.multiple_bonds AS number_of_multiple_bonds
FROM FilteredMolecules f
JOIN MoleculeAtomCounts a_counts ON f.molecule_id = a_counts.molecule_id
JOIN MoleculeBondCounts bcounts ON f.molecule_id = bcounts.molecule_id
ORDER BY
  bcounts.carbon_touching_bonds DESC,
  a_counts.total_atoms DESC,
  a_counts.molecule_id ASC
LIMIT 1000;

  FROM bond

  JOIN atom a2 ON bond.atom2 = a2.atom

),

)

FROM EligibleBonds
WHERE element IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY element
ORDER BY element;
